a.xlink:title: Serializes ground canonical statements to WCNF character codes using the classic ``p wcnf`` format, assigning sequential variable numbers by first occurrence.

Serializes statements using the given WCNF format: ``old`` (``p wcnf`` header with a top weight, hard clauses carrying the top weight) or ``new`` (the format of the MaxSAT Evaluations from 2022, without header, with ``h`` for hard clauses).
Returns the top weight used by the ``old`` format: one plus the sum of the weights of the soft clauses.
Serializes statements with origins and returns ``line(Start, End, Origin)`` source-map entries; with the ``old`` format the generated header occupies line 1.
Returns the ordered ``Term-Number`` variable table that the serialization predicates assign by first occurrence across hard and soft clauses.
